VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: The only potential boundary is the dependence on the existence of irrationals in every neighbourhood—ensured by [L2] and [L3]. For any ε > 0, the interval N_ε(x) is nondegenerate and, because X is dense, must intersect X; the contradiction in step 1.2 therefore holds without caveat. No empty-set, zero-radius, or degenerate-interval edge case undermines the argument.
